messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Multiple plots in one page
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to make 3 plots in one page following Hadley's book code (a little bit modified) but I got the message "null device 1" (see below):

> a = ggplot(dfa, aes(y=b, x=a)) + geom_pointrange(limitesa, size = 1) + xlab("Categoría de Edad") + ylab("Porcentaje (%)") + opts(legend.position = "none") + theme_bw()
> b = ggplot(dfb, aes(y=b, x=a)) + geom_pointrange(limitesb, size = 1) + xlab("País") + ylab("Porcentaje (%)") + opts(legend.position = "none") + theme_bw()
> c = ggplot(dfc, aes(y=b, x=a)) + geom_pointrange(limitesc, size = 1) + xlab("Educación") + ylab("Porcentaje (%)") + opts(legend.position = "none") + theme_bw()
> pdf("grafico1.pdf",  width  =  8,  height  =  10)
> grid.newpage()
> pushViewport(viewport(layout  =  grid.layout(3,  1)))
> vplayout  <-  function(x,  y)
+ viewport(layout.pos.row  =  x,  layout.pos.col  =  y)
> print(a,  vp  =  vplayout(1,  1))
> print(b,  vp  =  vplayout(2,  1))
> print(c,  vp  =  vplayout(3,  1))
> dev.off()
null device
          1

Any hint what is going on?
Best,

Manuel

messages.subject: Re: Multiple plots in one page
parts:
My mistake actually, I meant ?dev.off. The message you reported is
displayed whenever the last open device is closed. It has nothing to
do with your ggplot graphic.

Try this:

pdf(file="DevOffTest1.pdf")
png(file="DevOffTest2.png")
dev.new()
dev.off()
dev.off()
dev.off()
dev.off()

-Ista
